info.title: SDDC Manager API Reference Guide
info.description: SDDC Manager is an integrated software stack that bundles the VMware virtualization and management components like compute virtualization (vSphere), storage virtualization (vSAN) and network virtualization (NSX)

put.description: Update depot settings. Depot settings can be updated with VMware Depot account

username.description: Depot Username for Access. This field is optional when downloadToken is used for online depot authentication and authorization.

password.description: Depot Password for Access. This field is optional when downloadToken is used for online depot authentication and authorization.

status.example: One among: DEPOT_UNKNOWN_HOST, DEPOT_NOT_AVAILABLE, DEPOT_USER_NOT_SET, DEPOT_INVALID_CREDENTIAL, UNKNOWN_FAILURE, DEPOT_CONNECTION_SUCCESSFUL

downloadToken.description: This field is mandatory when downloadToken is used for online depot authentication and authorization. downloadToken should be generated from the broadcom support portal https://support.broadcom.com

downloadActivationCode.description: This field is mandatory when downloadActivationCode is used for online depot authentication and authorization. downloadActivationCode should be generated from the broadcom support portal https://support.broadcom.com

isOfflineDepot.description: Flag indicating if the depot is in offline mode

url.description: Depot URL (Currently used only for VCF offline depot). Supports HTTP no-auth for unauthenticated offline depot access.

DepotSettings.description: VMware Depot Settings. At least one of vmwareAccount or offlineAccount value must be provided

arguments.description: The arguments used to localize the message, Can be used by scripts to automate the error processing.

items.description: The arguments used to localize the message, Can be used by scripts to automate the error processing.

additionalProperties.description: The error context (e.g. the component where it occurred).

context.description: The error context (e.g. the component where it occurred).

notifications.description: Detailed results of the precheck validation.

nestedErrors.description: The nested errors when the error is a composite one

referenceToken.description: A reference token correlating the error with the relevant detailed error logs. Should be sent to the service provider when reporting issues.

remediationUrl.description: The URL string for remediation documentation link

Error.description: Error response containing a minor error code, a localized error message, a localized remediation message and optionally a reference token to correlate the error with the logs

type.description: The type of the error cause

message.description: The message describing the reason for the error

Remediation.description: Remediation conveys the remediation message and the associated link.

severity.description: Severity level of the notification. Supported values: INFO/ERROR/WARNING

remediations.description: List of steps and associated info to remediate the issue.

impactMessage.description: Impact of precheck failure or warning.

ValidationNotification.description: Represents the detailed result of the precheck validation.
